# Combat options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

13 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `Combat`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AuraCritSuppressionPercent` | `float` | `1.8` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Percent a player's crit from auras (stances, talents, crit on gear) is cut against a creature three or more levels above it, on top of the weapon-skill term; never more than the aura crit itself. Default 1.8, retail: Blizzard confirmed such a modifier exists in 1.12 and on its Classic servers without giving its size (Aggrend, 2019-07-10, https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/bug-berserker-stance/196414), and 1.8 is the Classic combat-log estimate (https://github.com/magey/classic-warrior/wiki/Crit-aura-suppression). 0 turns the cut off (vmangos and cmangos-classic, which only apply the weapon-skill term). Melee and ranged attacks and abilities; spells are not affected. |
| `CastResetsMeleeSwing` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | A non-triggered cast of a spell whose interrupt flags carry SPELL_INTERRUPT_FLAG_COMBAT (0x08), without Ex2 0x20000, restarts the main-hand (and off-hand) swing timer when it is cast (vmangos Spell::cast, Spell.cpp:3805-3810). Default true, retail; false is a deviation that leaves the timers alone. |
| `CastingConsumesSwing` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | How a blocked swing is handled while `MeleeCastingBlocksSwing` applies (ranged (autorepeat lane)). Default false, retail: `Unit::UpdateMeleeAttackingState` returns before it looks at any swing timer while a non-melee spell is cast (Unit.cpp:415-421; mangos-classic Unit.cpp:650-654 has the same order), so the swing happens as soon as the cast ends. True is the deviation that predates this lane: the swing timer is consumed and restarted, the swing is lost, not delayed. |
| `MeleeCastingBlocksSwing` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Whether a unit casting a non-melee spell loses its melee swing (vmangos Unit::AttackerStateUpdate, Unit.cpp:2240-2241: `if (!extra && IsNonMeleeSpellCasted(false)) return`). Default true, the retail behaviour; the swing timer still restarts, so the swing is lost, not delayed. |
| `MeleeMovementLeeway` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Whether a white swing's reach grows by the 2.66 yd movement leeway when a player is involved and both units move without walking (vmangos Unit::GetCombatReachToTarget, Unit.cpp:10374-10394, and GetLeewayBonusRangeForTargets, Object.cpp:1890-1897). Default true, retail: Blizzard ruled "Melee leeway is working as intended in both PvE and PvP" on its 1.12-reference WoW Classic servers and "for players with low latency, the state of melee leeway is how they would have experienced the game in 2006" (Kaivax, WoW Classic "Not A Bug" list, https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/wow-classic-not-a-bug-list/175887/23). False is the deviation without it. The melee abilities' leeway follows `Ranged:Range:Leeway` with every other spell range. |
| `RateEnergy` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | vmangos Rate.Energy: multiplies the energy regeneration (Player.cpp:2320). |
| `RateHealth` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | vmangos Rate.Health: multiplies spirit health regeneration and the aura-161 flat bonus. Must not be negative. |
| `RateMana` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | vmangos Rate.Mana: multiplies the mana regeneration (Player.cpp:2291). Must not be negative. |
| `RateRageIncome` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | vmangos Rate.Rage.Income: multiplies the rage a player gains from damage (Player.cpp:2264). |
| `RateRageLoss` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | vmangos Rate.Rage.Loss: multiplies the out-of-combat rage decay (Player.cpp:2313). Must not be negative. |
| `RequireShapeshiftFormDbc` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Refuse to start without `ShapeshiftFormDbcPath` instead of falling back to the built-in build-5875 table (`ShapeshiftFormCatalog.Retail`). Default false. |
| `ShapeshiftFormDbcPath` | `string` | `""` | text | World | start | Path of the client's SpellShapeshiftForm.dbc (build 5875). Empty = only the three warrior stances are known. |
| `StanceShiftKeepsSelfBuffs` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Whether switching between warrior stances keeps the stance-bound buffs the unit cast on itself (Retaliation, Recklessness, Shield Wall). Default false: vmangos removes them with the old stance (SpellAuras.cpp:5565-5575, SpellAuraHolder::m_isRemovedOnShapeLost). Patch 1.7.0 is quoted by vmangos as saying they are no longer cancelled (SpellAuras.cpp:5537-5539), but its code for that sits in a block excluded from the 1.12.1 build, so the code is followed. |
